notes: Everything the web can do, now in the app: every Settings section (users and roles, WhatsApp linking, sign-in codes and authenticator 2FA, email, branding, Returned watermark, light and dark, LDAP, UniFi), the Product Catalog with brand logos and product photos, imports and exports, deleted contracts and notification channels. Assets show their photo and brand logo, and the dashboard has the web's in-use ring, status donut and quick actions.
